---
title: "Evaluation"
---

## Daily evaluation

The `main` branch is evaluated automatically on a daily basis.

### Evaluation steps

1. Checkout latest code from `main`.
2. Compile sources in `src/`.
3. Link against required libraries (`estia-image`, `getopt`, `math`).
4. Run feature tests if build succeeds.
5. Publish results through branch updates and a pull request report.

### Advice

- Ensure `main` compiles before end of day.
- Do not use extra libraries beyond course requirements.
- Keep source files under `src/`.
- Avoid unnecessary files in `src/`.

## Final evaluation

Final evaluation uses the same logic on archived repositories at the end deadline.

### Passing grade requirements

- At least 3 milestones validated with at least 80% successful tests.
- At least 10% of team commits authored by each student.
- Presence in classes.
- No plagiarism detected.

### Advice

- Keep `main` buildable and testable at all times.
- Never copy code from internet, other teams, or AI output.
